profile.headline: Software Engineer at Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co.
profile.summary: Software engineer with 10 years of experience and a get-it-done on-time aptitude seeking for a challenging position. My background is in the full life-cycle of software development process including requirements definition, design, coding, testing, debugging, maintenance and integration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• In the process of rewriting existing ERP applications to bring them more to date technologically
• In the process of stablishing a more agile development environment within the team
• Working closely with the enterprise architectural team on Docker/Kubernetes prove of concepts
• Eliminated manual processes by implementing technology
• Gathered requirements, transformed them into technical and business requirements and developed based on them.
• Created a PowerApps application as a proof of concept
• Integrated local apps with OKTA’s APIs
• Technologies used: .Net Core, ASP.Net, C#, SQL, EF 6, eStelPlan, Oracle, LINQ, VS and Docker for Windows
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Scrum · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microsoft Azure · DevOps · Agile Methodologies · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · .NET Core · Azure DevOps Services · Microsoft Office · ASP.NET Web API · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development · ASP.NET Core · API Development · REST APIs · Technical Specs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created REST APIs
• Modified SOAP phone service logic to company’s needs
• Gathered requirements, analyzed and integrated interface reporting data to new quoting system
• Participated in Nationwide’s yearly Hackathon where my team proposed an innovative quoting idea using Microsoft’s CustomVision AI, SQL technology in Azure servers, .Net, Web APIs and C#
• Interim lead developer  
• Interim scrum master  
• Technologies used: Visual Studio 2012 and 2017, C#, Entity Framework, TFS, GitHub, Azure Repos, Oracle, Splunk, Apigee, Postman, CI/CD through Azure DevOps and SOAPui in Agile environment
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Agile Application Development · Agile Methodologies · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · Azure DevOps Services · Microsoft Office · ASP.NET Web API · HTML5 · Analytical Skills · Web Services API · Back-End Web Development · API Development · REST APIs · Business Process · Technical Specs

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
• Integrated in house application with vendor’s application to facilitated collateralized debt obligation trades
• Gathered requirements, designed and developed web form application to consume vendor’s web service
• Updated existing applications and database schema by adding/modifying tables, stored procedures and triggers in order to integrate new trade type
• Created new ActiveBatch jobs to process the consumption and parsing of transferred fixed text file data
• Technologies used: Visual Studio, ASP.Net, C#, Classic ASP, SQL, LINQ, TFS, HTML, JavaScript, ActiveBatch and SOAPui in Agile environment
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microsoft Office · ASP.NET Web API · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development · Technical Specs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Analyzed main application’s data and database in order to improve performance
• Implemented architectural changes to main application 
• Took care of web forms improvements and bugs as required 
• Met with clients in order to design new reports and solve existing issues with Plateau Successfactors reporting tool 
• Created and updated certificate image templates
• Main technologies used:  Visual Studio, ASP.Net, C#, SQL, LINQ, TFS, Redgate, HTML, CSS, Gimp and JavaScript
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · Microsoft Office · ASP.NET Web API · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Technology Lead Consultant
positions.description:
• On bench pending third party contract matching 
• Training by InfoSys

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Integrated into existing system a dynamic web application parallel to its development by sister company using service bus and REST connections to estimate recording costs
• Created logic to request/response based on the abstract data type nature of application above   
• Integrated into existing system a REST web application (AddressBroker) to standardize and validate physical addresses 
• Integrated after research and learn on my own how to create Crystal and Telerik reports
• Upgraded Crystal reports from outdated version to newest
• Improved performance of existing Crystal reports by moving logic to SQL stored procedures and in some instances creating indexes on existing tables
• Created several new web forms for tracking and processing of data 
• Technically reviewed, gathered, clarified and requested information before starting new projects
• Suggested improvements on projects as they were being developed in order to prevent bugs
• Analyzed and interpreted years of data to present to director of development to either merge or delete orphan records
• Served as interpreter, developer and creative force behind some projects among directors, business analysts and other stakeholders up to rewriting requirements in a way that all parts were satisfied and all requests were met  
• Took care of improvements and bugs as required on hybrid (classic and .Net, web forms) web application 
• Main technologies used: ASP.Net, C#, SQL, LINQ, TFS, VB, ASP, VBScript, JQuery, Crystal Reports, HTML, Telerik Controls and CSS
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · Microsoft Office · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development · Technical Specs

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Integrated MarketingPro’s website with Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn using their REST APIs to allow MarketingPro’s clients to:
-Link their MarketingPro account to their Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn accounts
-Retrieve names, birthdays, profile pictures, friends’ information, followers’ and following subjects’ names from these three social media outlets
-Retrieve and display news feeds (status updates, pictures, videos, links, etc.) from each of these social media outlets mimicking their own feel and look styles on MarketingPro’s own website. This would allow MarketingPro’s clients to check their social media outlets feeds from MarketingPro’s website without the need to login into those social media outlets separately
-Post status updates or tweets, pictures, videos and links on behalf of MarketingPro’s clients to Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn
• Created a new feature using their helpdesk ticket system, Zendesk’s REST API to obtain real time support tickets data
• Set an ASP.Net(C#) iframe within a classic ASP(VB) web form to display tickets data
• Modified the website to make it compile both .CS and .VB code files inside the App_Code folder
• Updated and upgraded existing classic ASP web forms to ASP.Net web forms
• Created desktop apps and web services that allow merging of up to three videos into one, backs up original videos, downloads videos from archive server, resizes and uploads merged video using both SFTP and FTP protocols to archive and production servers, and updates the database through each stage of the work batch.  
• Created a video player in HTML5 with JQuery that plays multiple videos as one, giving the user the ability to mute, pause, rewind and forward in-between videos as if they were only one single video
• Created some macros in Excel spreadsheets to give users the ability to color sort data with the click of a button
• Created a form where users are able to test their email server credentials for account set up purposes
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · Microsoft Office · HTML5 · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Maintained understanding of current web technologies or programming practices through continuing education, reading or participating in professional conferences, webinars or training sessions 
• Incorporated technical considerations into web site design, such as budgets, equipment, performance requirements, or legal issues including accessibility and privacy 
• Served as lead developer for some projects by evaluating code to ensure that it was valid, properly structured, met industry standards and was compatible with browsers, devices, or operating systems
• Identified and corrected problems revealed by testing or customers’ feedback
• Collaborated in multiple simultaneous projects, meeting all budget and timeframes
• Set up, managed and maintained GoldenComm’s email blast services through SendGrid for customers
• Conducted training on professional skills
• Coded against Microsoft HealthVault and Omron Fitness with OAuth authorization for data retrieval
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Communication · Web Application Development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Technical Requirements · Web Applications · Microsoft Office · Analytical Skills · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Document Imaging Administrator
positions.description:
• Developed web forms and applications in C# and ASP.NET that manage data in SQL databases
• Developed various desktop applications in C#
• Developed form capturing templates and workflows in Cardiff Teleforms systems
• Developed data parsing applications for data captured in CSV format
• Upgraded old Visual Basic 6 applications using C# and ASP.NET
• Created new several PDF forms
• Created, deleted and modified tables and stored procedures as needed
• Created new In.Vision web applications hosted in our Java Servlet
• Modified existing websites by adding javascripts
• Independently learned how to use Omnipage data capturing software and developed templates and workflows
• Trained payroll department's manager on data capturing from PDF files to CSV/Excel files using Omnipage
• Migrated IIS websites from one server to another
• In charge of all document imaging SQL databases
• Interact on a daily basis with SQL procedures
• In charge of programs and systems updates as necessary
• Update and maintain detailed documentation for each division of our department (technical writing)
• In charge of maintaining 14 active Windows base servers
• Developed new procedures for scanning and data upload of secured documents and contracts
• Trained one-to-one and groups on scanning and retrieval of documents and their procedures
• Assist other members of the IT department as needed
positions.insights: Skills: Transact-SQL (T-SQL) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Microsoft Office · Analytical Skills
